econ-game-01-c3.text: Steven Kuhn (2025). Prisoner's Dilemma. Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy.
econ-game-01-c3.quote: whatever the other does, each is better off confessing than remaining silent
econ-game-01-c3.claim: If you're one of the suspects, defection is better regardless of what the other does.

econ-game-01-c3.text: Steven Kuhn (2025). Prisoner's Dilemma. Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy.
econ-game-01-c3.quote: (C,C) is strictly preferred by each to (D,D)
econ-game-01-c3.claim: Individual rationality leads to a collectively bad outcome.
